i.norm: Encodes each string and asserts it matches the expected NYSIIS encoding.

Verifies that phonetically similar names with different spellings (e.g. "Smith" and "Schmit") both encode to the same NYSIIS key ("SNAT"), demonstrating the algorithm's ability to group similar-sounding surnames together.
